## Constraints

### Must

- Keep demo, partial, and live provider states visually explicit.
- Preserve the three-pane workspace on desktop and a drawer-based mobile layout.
- Keep primary interactions keyboard accessible with visible focus states.

### Avoid

- Do not imply consumer Meta AI chat is directly connected.
- Do not present model agreement as verified correctness.
- Avoid oversized marketing headlines inside the working interface.

## Decisions

- Use a warm-neutral, compact editorial workspace with acid-lime actions and provider-specific seat colors so four parallel contributions remain easy to scan.
